title: The X on the bulk bar leaves bulk mode and clears the ticks
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active parts, part A and part B.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  3. Click Deactivate parts.
  4. Click the part A row.
  5. Click the part B row.
  6. Click the X at the right end of the dark bar.
  7. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮).
  8. Press Escape.
  9. Click the part A row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • Bulk mode turns on.

Step 4:

  • The part A row is ticked.

Step 5:

  • The bar reads 2 selected.

Step 6:

  • Bulk mode ends: the dark bar and the checkbox column disappear, nothing is ticked, and the search and filter row is back directly under the tabs.

Step 7:

  • The menu is back to normal: "Cycle count", "Deactivate parts", "Export".

Step 8:

  • The menu closes.

Step 9:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A (the row is not ticked), and parts A and B are still on the Active tab.
